detail.longDescription: New ties release: 0.4.0 :) ties is a social bookmark manager aiming for federation over ActivityPub and compatibility with the rest of the fediverse. Highlights in this release are the invite system and an overhauled bookmarking flow. Also contains security fixes, including updated CA certificates in the container we publish. https:// github.com/raffomania/ties/rel eases/tag/v0.4.0 # fediverse # selfhosted # activitypub # rust # htmx
